description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. List every animated-overlay scene kind with metadata (label, whether it animates, whether it's a cam-frame, and whether it's creatable via this agent surface -- with a one-line reason when it isn't). The four sheet-pack kinds (panel-pack, label-pack, sub-badge-pack, emote-pack) also carry `tileInputs` -- their fixed slot count, whether tile labels are locked to fixed vocabulary (sub-badge-pack only), and how the sheet is billed -- pass per-tile overrides for them as `tileTexts` in plan_overlay_pack. This is the single source of truth for scene kinds; never assume or hardcode a kind name.
name: list_scene_kinds
title: List animated-overlay scene kinds
